positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Symbian S60 email client, based on Microsoft ActiveSync
- Developed the Email setup wizard on Symbian^4 platform, from the involvement in the UI design to the implementation, using Qt, to the unit testing, using QtestLib.
- Developed the Email setup wizard on Symbian^3 platform.
- Developed the feature to support the ActiveSync device security policies, such as enforcement of device lock and device password handling.
- Developed the UI feature that provided the ActiveSync Autodiscover service for email account creation.
